crossRefs.note: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.
Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of…
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and…
But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and…
But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.

translations.web: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
translations.bsb: Riches may ransom a man’s life, but a poor man hears no threat.
translations.kjv: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
translations.asv: The ransom of a man's life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.
